scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run desktop:build && bun --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && bun --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run desktop:typecheck
scripts.test: bun test tests/free-model-selector.test.ts tests/core.test.ts tests/agent.test.ts tests/contracts.test.ts tests/cloud.test.ts tests/cloud-sandbox.test.ts tests/cloud-diff.test.ts tests/desktop-security.test.ts tests/desktop-sponsor.test.ts tests/cli-terminal.test.ts tests/cli-permissions.test.ts tests/cli-threads.test.ts tests/cli-chat.test.ts tests/desktop-local-agent.test.ts tests/shell-platform.test.ts tests/cli-update.test.ts tests/desktop-updater.test.ts tests/desktop-packaging.test.ts tests/recovery-retention.test.ts tests/recovery-restore.test.ts tests/bundled-notices.test.ts tests/recovery-drive.test.ts tests/recovery-scheduled.test.ts tests/recovery-master-key.test.ts tests/browser-chat.test.ts tests/chat-history.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: bun --env-file=.env.test.local test tests/db.integration.test.ts && bun --env-file=.env.test.local test tests/github-cloud.integration.test.ts
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run desktop:build && bun --cwd apps/desktop start
